texts.preamble: Jitendra Malviya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 July, 2025 Author: Pranay Verma Bench: Pranay Verma Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Ind:17255 1 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Indore Before Hon'Ble Shri Justice Pranay Verma On The 9 th Of July, 2025 Writ Petition No. 20153 of 2025 Jitendra Malviya Versus The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others Appearance: Shri Sudhanshu Vyas - Advocate with Ms. Vishaka Mishra, counsel for the petitioner. Dr. Amit Bhatia- Ga for the State. Order
texts.arguments: By this petition preferred under Article 226 of Constitution of India, the petitioner challenged the order dated 02.06.2025 (Annexure-P/3) passed by the Sub Divisional Officer (Revenue) Shajapur, District Shajapur whereby he has been placed under suspension from the post of Sarpanch under section 39 (1)(a) of Madhya Pradesh Panchayat Raj Avam Gram Swaraj Adhiniyam,1993 (hereinafter referred as "the Adhiniyam" ). 2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that as per provisions of section 39 (1)(a) of the Adhiniyam, the office bearer of panchayat can be placed under suspension only when the charge is framed in any criminal case mentioned in the said section. It is submitted that in the present case, a case under section 137(2), 96, 64(2)(M) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Sanhita, 2023 and Section 5 (L) read with section 6 of the Protection of Children from NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:17255 2 WP-20153-2025 Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012 has been registered against the petitioner at Police Station- Barotha, District- Dewas but no charge has been framed. 3 . The respondents have filed the reply to the petition but nowhere therein it has been stated as to whether any charge has been framed against the petitioner. The petitioner has made specific avernment in the petition that no charge has been framed in the criminal case. - (1) The prescribed authority may suspend from office any office-bearer,- (a) against whom charges have been framed in any criminal proceedings under [Chapters V-A, VI, IX], IX-A, X, XII, Sections 302, 303, 304-B, 305, 306, 312 to 318, 366-A, 366-B, 373 to 377 of Chapter XVI, Sections 395 to 398, 408, 409, 458 lo 460 of Chapter XVII and Chapter XVIII of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (XLV of 1860) or under any Law for the time being in force for the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:17255 3 WP-20153-2025 prevention of adulteration of food stuff and drugs, [suppression of immoral traffic in women and children, Protection of Civil Rights and Prevention of Corruption]; 5.
